svg.title: Wrecking-ball demolition — Niðurrif með höggkúlu
svg.desc: A lattice-boom crawler suspends a heavy round wrecking ball beside the broken edge of a wall.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-wrecking-ball-demolition","label_en":"Wrecking-ball demolition","label_is":"Niðurrif með höggkúlu","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["demolition","impact"],"description":"A lattice-boom crawler suspends a heavy round wrecking ball beside the broken edge of a wall.","design_note":"A freely hanging solid-mass outline and broken wall clearly convey impact demolition, not a lifting hook.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
